MediSystem Pharmacy
provides access to specialized health monitoring solutions, including continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems, remote patient monitoring (RPM) coordination, and guidance on integrating consumer wearables like smartwatches or ECG trackers for chronic care management
Wearable Health Technologies
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Prescription devices like the FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom place a small sensor under the skin to track interstitial glucose levels in real time.
YouTube
Stanford Health Care
Smartwatches & Wearables:
Used alongside apps to display fitness, heart rate, and synced glucose trends, though non-invasive wrist-based blood sugar tracking lacks formal regulatory clearance.
U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov)
Wearable ECG & Sleep Trackers:
Wrist devices monitor heart rhythms and sleep architecture to support cardiovascular and recovery insights.
Amazon.in
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Data Transmission:
Securely relays vital signs (blood pressure, glucose, weight) from home devices to clinical care teams.
Chronic Disease Support:
Enables proactive management for conditions like diabetes and hypertension outside clinical settings.
PubMed Central (PMC) (.gov)
